checkout.marketing: Tell me about similar concerts in Riyadh (you can turn this off any time).

checkout.eventMissing: Event is missing — open seats from the event page again
checkout.ticketMissing: Ticket type is missing for this order
checkout.promoNeedOrder: Create seats first so we can apply a promo
